dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Sharp, continuous 2D narrowing of the lateral margins from the mid-section toward a pointed posterior termination.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Notable asymmetrical bulge on the upper-left lateral margin followed by a shallow indentation; the right lateral margin displays a more uniform convex curve.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform medium-grey intensity across the dorsal plane, with a narrow band of higher reflectance along the central longitudinal ridge.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of fine, low-contrast white linear streaks (rake marks) clustered on the posterior dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear scarring on the posterior dorsal region, consistent with rake marks.
